diagnosis: 1) The owner's phone (about 361 dp) falls on the "large text" side of ad-hoc breakpoints (TaskCard `width < 380`, search bar and panels `< 360`, while Home and the tab bar use `< 340`), so he permanently sees stacked, 290-330 dp cards (1.1 to 1.5 per screen) and a crammed search pill, never the compact layouts the design was made for, and that is what reads as poor overview and "big and repetitive". 2) There is no icon system: five drawing dialects share one screen (FactArt 2.5D stickers, flat HomeLaunchArt, gradient Pictogram, glossy Catalog27 PNGs, thin Phosphor lines), the sticker detail turns to mush at the 16-20 px it is actually used at, hue alternates orange/green per kind against the project's own one-accent rule, one bubble silhouette means three things, ticks sit on unconfirmed terms, and primary controls (filters, calendar) are icon-only. 3) Hierarchy is flat and colour is overloaded: titles, section headings and prices are all bold 20 px ink or green, status is the smallest element on every card, green means action, selection, money and an unconfirmed time at once, and the urgent "Čeka te" list is drawn quieter than the less urgent next Dogovor. 4) Motion exists only as press-scale and late-row fades while every state change is a cut: tab switch, push (fades in from white), Back (hard cut), the 1-2 s skeleton rebuild when returning to Zadaci, data arrival, photo pop-in, chip fold and sheet-end pops, plus a haptic and a shrink on touch-down that fire when a scroll merely starts; all fixes must obey the B22 Reanimated constraint (fewer long-lived views, RN Animated native driver for new motion, no layout or exiting animations). 5) Screens were guarded piece by piece but never composed as one product: the Home doors dropped the entry's photographic warmth and look like clip-art, the Zadaci map and list behave like two screens joined by a floating button, the cards are text-only twins, and the compare screen is a grid of pale panels rather than a comparison. 6) Several screens are unclear for plain reasons that are cheap to fix: wrong empty states (a filter reset on a section with no filter), contradicting counts, a ragged state line on the task detail, prijava/ponuda and five phrasings of "flexible", orphan dots and dates broken mid-date, and a conversation that has no visible name on the Dogovor screen.

waves.goal: Systemic foundations that every later screen inherits: one token/layout-class set, one size-aware icon cut with a single tone rule, one press-and-haptic feel, plus the BEFORE evidence. Order inside the wave: 1.1 and 1.2 first (small, tokens), then 1.3, 1.4 and 1.5 in parallel on disjoint files.

items.title: 1.1 BEFORE evidence and device facts
items.change: Extend scripts/qa_device.py with a read-only probe script (owner window only, foreground check before every input, never clear data or sign out): read `wm size`, `wm density` and the real font_scale to settle the 361 dp / text-scale question that decides item 1.5; screen-record 60 fps for tab switch, push and Back from Zadaci/Dogovori/Početna, cold list arrival and a 20-flick scroll started on a card (count touch-down haptics/shrinks); record gfxinfo janky %, p50/p95/p99, Davey >= 700 ms and the B22 failed-line counts per frame, with build SHA. Also capture the screens this audit could not see: map with pin card, Home with a populated Čeka te, Zadaci filter panel, Dogovor Pregled, chat, /nova, profile. These numbers are the BEFORE for every later wave.

items.title: 1.2 Tokens, layout class, motion rules, colour meaning
items.change: In tokens.ts add to sys.motion: tab 150, fade 160, push 240, sheetSpring (move SHEET_SPRING out of ProductSheet, delete springSheet), pressScale {button 0.97, row 0.985}, loop tier (breath 700, typing 520, glow 1600) and an 'arrive' moment tier; add `sys.color.art` (brand/accent/quiet/danger tones derived from sys.color.green so FactArt stops owning hex values); write the four-line colour-meaning table next to sys.color (green = do/selected/money, ink = content, muted = unknown/meta, warn = waits for you, orange = attention counts only) and the eight motion rules (R1-R8 from the motion audit) as a comment and in DESIGN_SKILLS.md. In textScale.ts add one `useLayoutClass()` ('large' = scale >= 1.3, 'narrow' = width < 340; components stack when either) and a guard test that no component reads window width directly (allow-list shrinking per wave). Extend one-token-source.test.ts to fail on numeric `duration:`, `damping:` and `scaleTo={0.9x}` literals outside tokens.ts (explicit allow-list for the locked entry scene and camera).
items.owner: Tokens agent (sole writer of tokens.ts for W1; later waves edit it only when sequential)

items.title: 1.3 FactArt: flat mark cut at 24 px and below, one tone rule, no false ticks, distinct silhouettes
items.change: Keep FactArt as the one fact-icon API (binding) and add: size ladder 16/20/24/32/48/64 and `cut` auto-selected by size (<= 24 'mark', >= 28 'art', so the ~135 call sites need no edit). Mark cut: no ground shadow, no edge, no shine; one fill tone plus one white detail; no tone lighter than 3:1 on white; minimum stroke 2.4 units; both people in 'users' get the full tone; calendar = body + header band + two ring ticks + two lines; tasks = clipboard + two lines; money = one note + circle. Replace ORANGE_KINDS/MUTED/GREEN/ORANGE consts with `tone: 'brand'|'accent'|'quiet'|'danger'` (default brand = single hue; `muted` kept as alias of quiet; orange only on bell, star, urgent, waiting, counts), derived from sys.color.art. Remove ticks from calendar, tasks and remote in both cuts (an unconfirmed term must not wear a confirmation tick). New drawings: 'offers' becomes a price tag (no longer the chat/agreements bubble), 'alert' (replaces 'info' as the error picture), 'publish' (sheet + plus, distinct from the 'tasks' clipboard), 'send' (paper plane); keep 'agreements' bubble+check. Add FACT_MEANING (one phrase per kind) with a uniqueness test and rewrite fact-art.test to assert cut per size and a contrast floor. Write ICON_SYSTEM.md (three registers: FactArt = what a thing is, Glyph = what you do, StatusMark = where it stands) and render the ladder on the dizajn-tabla board for before/after. Do not touch HomeIllustration, entry assets or Pictogram pickers.

items.title: 1.4 Press feel: haptics are outcomes, one scale ladder, fewer animated views
items.change: In Press.tsx add `hapticOn: 'in' | 'release'` with default 'release' (the tick fires inside onPress, so starting a scroll on a card no longer ticks or shrinks the phone); explicit 'in' only for toggles where the tick is the change (set it in Segmented.tsx; the tab bar adds it in W2); success/error haptics stay reachable through V2Action `success`/`error`. Default scale ladder from sys.motion.pressScale (0.97 button, 0.985 row/card, 1 none) replacing 0.94/0.98/0.986/0.99. When scaleTo === 1 render a plain Pressable without shared value or animated style (StaticPress). Add `usePressLift()` (shared give/settle/lift, one constant) as a new hook for later adoption by TaskCard, ApplicationFace and AgreementCollectionPresentation. In Appear.tsx latch the mode at mount (a row that mounted settled renders a plain View and never switches element type) and add `settle(keys, viewKey, {afterLoading})` so a first list after a skeleton can arrive once (adoption per screen in later waves; warm return and filter change stay still). Defer the decision to move Press itself to RN Animated until W1.1 numbers exist.

items.title: 1.5 Show the designed card layout on the owner's phone (threshold flip)

items.title: 9.1 Candidates list: one leader per row, visible sort, one star, one glossary
items.change: Replace the sort dropdown with an inline two-option segmented control 'Redom | Najniža cena' on one row with the counts (keep CandidateSort and onSort props); row = 48 dp avatar + 17/700 name + rating on the left, amount 20/700 money right-aligned with 'ukupno · 1 osoba · termin' under it, message as a 2-line quote, StatusChip only when not SELECTABLE (a chosen row gets a check glyph on the avatar instead of repeating a label); separator in the neutral line colour, not green; show 'Uporedi' only with at least two SELECTABLE offers. Star = FactArt star mark cut 16 px, tone accent, aligned to the first text line (ratingWords '5 (4)' form when narrow). Glossary: 'prijava' is the object, 'ponuda' only the amount ('Prikaži ponude' becomes 'Lista'); owner-fixed CHOICE_TITLE and CHOOSE_LABEL stay untouched.

items.title: 9.2 Compare as a table
items.change: White surface, row labels pinned on the left, offers as horizontally scrolling columns (3+ work, 320 dp and 1.3 scale decided explicitly), first row Ukupno with a small 'Najniža' mark derived only from cena.iznos, rows identical across all offers muted or collapsed into 'Isto za sve', name on one line with ellipsis (full name in the sheet) so the dead gap disappears, rating on one line; header = back arrow + short title 'Uporedi' with no right action; each column stays one accessible button heard as the whole offer.

items.title: 9.3 Pregled zadatka: state line, applications first, one rule, capacity in dots
items.change: Stack the state: StatusChip on its own line, then the detail as a full-width 14/500 sentence with no leading dot ('Dogovoreno 1 od 2. Traženje za ostala mesta je zatvoreno.'); when remainingClosed the chip says 'Zatvoreno za nove prijave', not 'Objavljen' (copy over existing flags, no new state). Move the 'Prijave' summary row directly under hero/state ('2 prijave · 0 za izbor', orange count pill only when something waits), remove the double hairline (drop applications.borderBottomWidth); keep the footer CTA and the title in the first hero block (scroll-title handoff). Capacity row = SlotMeter + 'Dogovoreno 1 od 2'; OFFERS mode shows 'Ponude umesto cene' with the price-tag glyph. Update the pinned strings in task-detail-round3 and pkg011-slice4 tests together.

waves.verifyOnPhone: Candidates with 1, 2 and 6 offers, a three-line name, real photo vs initials, a chosen row; compare with 2, 3 and 5 offers, equal and different prices, 1.3 text (state what replaces compare at large text); Pregled for a task with remainingClosed, a draft, a filled and a closed task, and with 0, 2 and 3 applications (applications visible without scrolling, no double hairline, scroll-title handoff intact); star on the same line as the number; TalkBack reads each row once.

waves.goal: Dogovori: one Dogovor drawn one way everywhere, a workspace that reads as a status board with a visible conversation.

items.title: 10.1 One AgreementRow and TermLine everywhere
items.change: New AgreementRow.tsx used by AgreementCollectionPresentation, the Home appointment card and AgendaRow: date block from the accepted instant (weekday + day, 'Danas'/'Sutra'), object title in the one green-title rule, person with a 24 px Avatar/photo, place, price right-aligned, attention foot unchanged, role wording from agreementRole(other) on Home and calendar too (no more 'Uskačeš' beside the same name). TermLine (from W4) replaces the three term renderings so an unconfirmed term is muted, never green. Optional second step: day section headers from calendarInstant in Europe/Belgrade (SectionList or interleaved header items) and a last group 'Bez tačnog termina'. No unread cue until it is verified that inbox items carry agreementId.

items.title: 10.2 Workspace: visible Pregled/Poruke tabs, one summary block, rare actions behind the menu, state motion
items.change: Render the existing AgreementTabs ('Pregled' | 'Poruke') under AgreementPersonBar in both panes and remove the unlabeled ChatCircle; the arrow always means 'back to the Dogovori list' (keep the tab state machine, BackHandler guards and ?tab=poruke&messageId deep link). Pregled: title as plain text with a quiet 'Otvori zadatak' link, ONE white summary block (term via TermLine, place, total in money colour, next-step sentence with state dot above it, single green footer action); move 'Izmene i otkazivanje', 'Bezbednost i privatna prijava' and 'Tok Dogovora' behind a '...' via useDetailMenu (same guarded screens); keep Kontakt and Lokacija as the only Disclosure rows; say 'Dogovor' once. Motion on state change: NextStepCard cross-fade + status dot 0.6 to 1 (RN Animated), Disclosure body via Reveal, rating stars filling left to right with a 30 ms stagger and no scale. No SVG stroke animation.

waves.verifyOnPhone: Aktivni with 1, 6 and 12 rows, a Dogovor without a term, a finished one awaiting rating; Početna card, calendar row and list row look identical; Back returns to the same scroll offset; all four workspace states (CONFIRMED, AWAITING_REQUESTER, COMPLETED, CANCELLED) for worker and requester, pending change proposal, open problem report, long title, 1.3 scale; open from list, from a message push and from Početna, hardware Back from both tabs; menu opens with TalkBack.

waves.goal: Conversation, photos and the one-job flows, so the most used part of a Dogovor feels alive and consistent.

items.title: 11.1 Chat bubbles, message arrival, photo viewer
items.change: Clock only on the last bubble of a same-sender run and inline for short messages; 'Osveži poruke' only on refreshError or empty-and-waiting; failed/unknown send keeps the own-bubble look with a 16 px danger glyph and 'Nije poslato · Pokušaj ponovo' (full copy behind a tap). New MessageArrive.tsx (RN Animated native driver, opacity + 6 px rise, 160 ms easeOut on the INNER bubble view only so row onLayout measurements stay untouched) for ids not displayed before and only while following the end; history, restore and local-message replacement stay still; scrollToEnd animated only for follow-ups near the end. Pane change Pregled/Poruke: 180 ms enter-only fade with 8 px shift. Own-bubble colour unified with sys.color.green (see needsOwner). New PhotoViewer.tsx (Modal, black ground, close X, pinch/double-tap zoom with the already-installed gesture-handler/reanimated, paging within a message, real aspect ratio capped 4:5) wired through AuthorizedPhoto scope props; opening it never counts as 'displayed' and private-photo authorization (bytes, no URL, no cache) is kept.

items.title: 11.2 Izmene form and completion review consistency
items.change: Izmene: group into two rows 'Početak' and 'Kraj' with a date well and a time well side by side (stack at scale >= 1.3), drop the FactArt icon from CivilField when its label already names the field (behind a prop, five screens share it), one 'Vreme unosiš po vremenu u Srbiji' note. Completion review: ScreenChrome variant 'flow' (X, 'Pregled završetka'), facts through AgreementTerms/agreementTerm so the zone line matches, single green confirm in FlowFooter; completion guards in [id].tsx untouched.

waves.verifyOnPhone: Long thread with runs, photos, pending/failed/unknown sends and a day change: scroll anchor, 'Najnovije poruke' and the displayed-message acknowledgement unchanged; send 5 messages quickly and receive one while scrolled up (no jump); photo open, zoom, page, rotate, Back closes the viewer not the Dogovor; keyboard open then tab switch; Izmene at 360 dp and 1.3 scale with correct civil values from the Android pickers; completion review for worker and requester.

waves.goal: Backlog behind owner or server gates (not started without the named gate).

items.title: 12.1 One FilterSheet for Zadaci and Moji zadaci
items.change: Single FilterSheet shell (ProductSheet): title + X with a quiet 'Obriši', groups as labelled chip rows (the existing Choice chip look), stepper for people, search field on top for Gde, footer = one green 'Prikaži N zadataka' (live region kept); replaces the five-card accordion modal and the radio-card sheet; keep draft/apply semantics, p6Search count preview, keyboard-above-footer, step ids and roles.
items.owner: Filters agent (after W6 and W8 stabilise)

items.title: 12.2 One composer for text, photo and voice
items.change: Pill [+] [field] [mic or send] (hold-to-talk sends on release, accessible mode reviews), 64 px thumbnail strip with X, privacy sentence as a first-use hint, recovery controls only in the recovery state, voice bubble with play circle and progress (waveform only if the contract carries peaks); voice parts behind voiceMessagesBuilt(). Blocked by the conditional expo-audio approval (compatibility check, no parallel audio stack) and the EXPO_PUBLIC_VOICE_MESSAGES build gate.
items.owner: Chat agent (after 11.1 and the owner's expo-audio decision)

items.title: 12.3 Retire Catalog27 PNGs on Podrška, Privatnost, Pravna dokumenta
items.change: Map CatalogArt kinds to FactArt lock/support/document/shield (art cut, brand tone) on the three screens; keep CatalogArt and the PNGs only in the internal gallery; disabled legal row uses tone quiet. Needs the owner's yes because he supplied the pack.

items.title: 12.4 Server-side pin price label and task photo thumbnail (candidates only)
items.change: Write NOT APPLIED candidates under supabase/candidates/ for a short price label and urgent flag in the MAP TASK bucket and, only if the owner agrees, a task-photo projection field; nothing is applied or deployed without his exact 'primeni' and the usual proof and certificate checks.

waves.verifyOnPhone: Each item has its own gate; none is started in this pass.

conflicts: ID convention: HP-* = Home auditor, Z1-Z12 = Zadaci auditor, MZ-* = Moji zadaci auditor (its S1, I1, D1, M1, C2, T1, N1, N2, H1, C1, K1, E1, X1), DG-F01..F13 = Dogovori/chat auditor, ICO-* = icons auditor, MO-M1..M13 = motion auditor.

Dogovor tab icon: HP-02 wants a new handshake, ICO-04 keeps bubble+check and only moves 'offers' to a price tag and 'chat' to a distinct bubble. Decision: ICO-04 now (it removes the three-way bubble collision without redrawing a navigation icon); handshake only as an A/B on the dizajn-tabla board.

Orange: Home, HP-02 and the 2026-09-22 'identical look' draw time and people in orange, while ICO-03, MZ-I1 and Z8 say orange is the one accent (tokens.ts and AGENTS 3.6.4). Decision: single brand tone in the 16-24 px mark cut, orange only for what waits, the art cut at 28 px and up may keep a small second hue; shown to the owner as an A/B first.

Animation engine: HP-03 (Reanimated shared value capsule), HP-05 (LinearTransition layouts, Appear stagger on the doors) and MO-M6 (Reanimated pill driven from sheet position) contradict the B22 constraint and MO-M5/M9 rules, and Z5/Z9 document that Reanimated loses writes near the Gorhom sheet on Android. Decision: B22 wins: new motion uses RN Animated with the native driver, no exiting or layout animations anywhere, fewer long-lived Reanimated views; the only Reanimated change allowed is interpolating inside the existing animatedIndex style of ListBackground.

SuccessMark: DG-F09(d) and ICO-09(b) want a stroke-dash drawn check via react-native-svg/animatedProps, MO-M12 wants View transform/opacity only because every SVG draw triggers the B22 replay. Decision: MO-M12 (ring + disc + pop); stroke-dash dropped.
Chip rail: Z9 deletes the fold, MO-M6 keeps it mounted and folds with opacity, Z2 rebuilds the rail with a 'Filteri' chip. Decision: rail always visible (Z2+Z9), fold deleted, so MO-M6(3) is moot.

Tab transitions: HP-03 optional fade, HP-09 'tune, do not rebuild', MO-M1 roots fade + one custom interpolator. Decision: MO-M1 stage 1, sequenced after the W1.1 recordings, with HP-09's tune-only version as the stated fallback; no nested Stack in this pass.

Zadaci top bar: Z2 replaces the '...' menu with a visible Objavi, HP-07(b) keeps '...' and adds an unread dot because the bell lives behind it. Decision: keep '...' with the unread dot (profile, bell and publish stay reachable), move only filters into a captioned chip; no extra Objavi chip until it is checked whether the map '+' already covers it.

Own-task cards: Z1 keeps 'Tražim ponude' as a small trailing label; MZ-S1/MZ-H1 say it is noise on own cards. Decision: by audience, workers (Zadaci, pin card) keep the pricing mode as a small trailing label, own cards (Moji zadaci) show a real state and the application count or nothing.

Title colour: TaskCard titles are green, ApplicationFace/CandidateFace/agreement titles are ink (MZ-S1, DG-F02). Decision: object titles are green 20/700 everywhere (the owner explicitly welcomed green titles), person names stay ink; status words stop being green so green means title, price and action.

Home doors: HP-01 uses the bundled entry photos; HP-02/ICO-12 prefer FactArt-built art. Decision: photo doors are the default (continuity with the approved V4.9 entry), FactArt art is the stated fallback; ICO-12 (port HomeLaunchArt) moves to backlog.

Zadaci strip tap: Z5 wants the half stop, but the code records a deliberate 'one tap opens the whole list' decision. Decision: keep full-list behaviour, only fix the pill; the half-stop default goes to the owner.

Phosphor duotone mapping per kind (DG-F01 option) vs the binding rule that FactArt is the one fact-icon system. Decision: dropped; FactArt (two cuts) draws facts, Glyph (Phosphor) draws controls only.
Z6 draws an orange ring for 'own' pins while ICO-03 reserves orange for attention. Decision: own = ink ring, applied = green disc with white check.
Captions on icon controls ('Filteri', 'Raspored') could look like orientation copy: allowed, they name a control, they do not say where you are; the no-eyebrow rule is untouched.

dropped: DG-F01 Phosphor weight='duotone' mapping per FactArt kind: contradicts the one-icon-system rule.
